title: Messaging & Event-Driven Architecture
intro: Kafka and event-driven architecture interview questions cover the messaging system that powers most modern Java backends — Kafka architecture (brokers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, ISR), delivery semantics (at-most-once, at-least-once, exactly-once), idempotent consumers, the outbox pattern, schema evolution, Kafka Streams vs Flink vs Spark Streaming, the saga pattern with choreography, CQRS and event sourcing, and Spring Kafka / Spring Cloud Stream. For RabbitMQ-specific questions (exchange types, routing, DLX), see the dedicated RabbitMQ page.
